cadence.daily_items: Per shift (OD/MD/ND = morning/afternoon/night), by the operator, within 30 minutes after start of shift; days Ma-Zo.
cadence.weekly_items: Once per week by the (assistant) shiftleader.

red_rule.rule_nl: Als de te controleren onderdelen met deze kleur afgevinkt worden met ROOD mag heftruck niet gebruikt worden. Veiligheid boven alles
red_rule.rule_en: If any checked item is ticked RED, the forklift may not be used. Safety above all.
red_rule.note: Items with critical=true have their label printed on a red background on the form (safety-critical functions).

pass_criteria_note: The form itself only offers a green (OK) / red (niet OK) tick per item; pass_criteria below are derived from the check text, not printed on the form.

items.check_nl: Met hoge druk reiniger heftruck reinigen
items.check_en: Clean the forklift with the high-pressure cleaner
items.transcription_note: Printed as 'hode druk' on the form; typo for 'hoge druk'.

items.check_en: Blow out cab and engine compartment with compressed air
items.pass_criteria: Cab and engine compartment blown clean with compressed air
No leaks found in engine compartment

items.check_nl: Beschadigingen aan frame rondom zoals aan lepels - balenklem of klem
items.check_en: Damage to frame all round, such as to forks, bale clamp or clamp
items.pass_criteria: No damage to frame, forks, bale clamp or clamp

items.check_en: Wire/thread wrapped around the wheel axles
items.pass_criteria: No wire/rope wound around wheel axles

items.check_nl: Banden loopvlak en of beschadigingen (stuk uit)
items.pass_criteria: Tyre tread OK, no chunks missing or damage

items.check_nl: Hydrauliek systeem Controle binnenkant mast op geleiderollen
items.check_en: Hydraulic system; check inside of mast for guide rollers
items.pass_criteria: Hydraulic system OK; mast guide rollers OK

items.check_nl: Mast maximaal naar voor en achter kantelen
items.check_en: Tilt mast fully forward and backward
items.pass_criteria: Mast tilts fully forward and backward without issue

items.check_nl: Klem of lepels maximaal uit elkaar / in elkaar
items.check_en: Move clamp or forks fully apart / together
items.pass_criteria: Clamp/fork positioning travels full range without issue

items.check_en: Brakes: foot brake and hand brake
items.pass_criteria: Foot brake and hand brake both function
Dead-man's pedal and/or emergency stop functions

items.check_en: Order and cleanliness of the vehicle
items.transcription_note: Unnumbered row at top of the weekly shiftleader section.

items.pass_criteria: Fan, radiator and drive belts OK

game_mapping_note: Form covers the in-game fleet: heftruck (forklift), heftruck with balenklem (bale clamp), Merlo (telehandler). Items 7-9 (mast checks) apply to mast vehicles (forklift/mast lift); item 3 and 10 explicitly mention lepels (forks) and balenklem (bale clamp).
